title: MIC database tool config
description: A job of the MIC database tool: the database, the application and where the output goes. Paths are relative to this file.

connectionString.description: The connection string the database is read with: the value itself, or env:NAME for an environment variable holding it, or file:path for a file holding it, the path relative to this file. Keep a secret out of a file that goes into a repository.

schemaConnectionString.description: The connection string schema changes run on when the script is applied, in the forms connectionString takes; the connection string itself when absent.

appAssembly.description: The path of the assembly holding the application, for the upgrade job.

appClass.description: For the upgrade job, the full name of the application's EntityApp class, the one such class in the assembly when absent; for the entities job, the name of the class written, DbApp when absent.

providerPath.description: The folder the provider and its driver are loaded from; the application assembly's folder when absent.

output.description: The path of the file the job writes; the job's default name in this file's folder when absent.

dropUnknownTables.description: Whether the upgrade script drops tables the model does not know.

ignoreDbObjects.description: Patterns of the database objects the upgrade script neither drops nor changes. Each is compared with an object's path, such as sales.Order.IX_Report_Month, ignoring case; * stands for any run of characters.

options.description: How the model is mapped to the database for the upgrade job: DbOptions flags separated by commas, from UseRefIntegrity, AutoIndexForeignKeys, PluralizeTableNames, AddSchemaToTableNames.

schemas.description: The schemas the entities job reads; every schema but the system ones when absent.

tables.description: The tables and views the entities job takes, as names or patterns with * and ?, a schema prefix allowed as in sales.Order*; every table of the schemas when absent.

ignoreTables.description: The tables and views the entities job leaves out, in the form tables takes.

namespace.description: The namespace the entities job writes.

module.description: The name of the module the entities job writes; the schema's name followed by Module when absent. With several schemas each module is named after its schema, this name appended.

lists.description: Whether the entities job writes a list member on a referenced entity for each entity referencing it.

autoGuidKeys.description: Whether the entities job marks a single-column Guid primary key [Auto].

addDbObjectsNames.description: Whether the entities job names every table, column, key and foreign key in an attribute, so that any identifier in the file can be renamed and the mapping stands. Off, a name is written only where it differs from what MIC would derive.
